newsitem.title: CHINA: China hotel reservations available on Internet.
newsitem.headline: China hotel reservations available on Internet.

text.p: Travellers all over the world will soon be able to book reservations at major hotels in China through the Internet, the China Daily said on Saturday.
The Beijing Telegraph Office and Beijing Intec Information Network Centre signed an agreement on Friday to build China's first travel information network, the newspaper said.
About a dozen Beijing star-rated hotels have joined the network and bookings through the Internet, which is expected to be available from November, it said.
Information is available through the network on about 500 hotels and travel agencies throughout China, although reservations are not yet available, it said.
